strings.zh: 阿笔馆主在上任之后,{NEWLINE}就把老旧的桧皮道馆改造成了{CLEAR}虫系精灵的巨大的~巢~穴。{SCROLL}虽然阿笔是位非常年轻的馆主,{NEWLINE}却能将虫系精灵自如地运用,{CLEAR}单论虫精灵领域的话,{CLEAR}他可是位非常厉害的专家！
strings.en: After Bugsy took over, he{NEWLINE}turned the old Azalea Gym into{CLEAR}a giant Bug Pokémon ~nest~.{SCROLL}Bugsy may be a very young Gym{NEWLINE}Leader, but he handles Bug types{CLEAR}with total ease. When it comes to{CLEAR}Bug Pokémon, he’s a real expert!

strings.zh: 干得不错嘛！{NEWLINE}年轻训练师之间的激烈对战……{SCROLL}精灵世界的未来有希望了！
strings.en: Well done! A fierce battle between{NEWLINE}young Trainers... The future of the{CLEAR}Pokémon world is bright!

strings.en: Azalea Town Pokémon Gym{SCROLL}Leader: Bugsy{NEWLINE}Certified Trainer!{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}

strings.zh: 哦！您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}您是来找阿笔馆主的吗？{CLEAR}真抱歉阿笔馆主现在不在道馆,{CLEAR}因为桐树林突然反常地{CLEAR}出现了大量虫精灵,{CLEAR}所以阿笔馆主现在正带人{CLEAR}在桐树林捉虫呢。
strings.en: Oh! You’re League Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}Are you here to see Bugsy? I’m so{CLEAR}sorry, he’s not at the Gym right now.{CLEAR}A huge number of Bug Pokémon suddenly{CLEAR}showed up in Ilex Forest, so he’s{CLEAR}leading a team there to catch them.

strings.zh: 我们桧皮道馆{NEWLINE}是专门研究虫系精灵的道馆,{CLEAR}因此研究出了不少虫系的强力技能。{SCROLL}你如果能从阿笔馆主那拿到徽章,{NEWLINE}我就把我的虫系绝招教给你。
strings.en: Our Azalea Gym specializes in studying{NEWLINE}Bug-type Pokémon, so we’ve come up{CLEAR}with quite a few powerful Bug moves.{SCROLL}If you get the Badge from Bugsy, I’ll{NEWLINE}teach you our Bug-type secret move.

strings.zh: 看来你已经取得昆虫徽章了。{SCROLL}那么你想学习我们桧皮道馆{NEWLINE}的虫系绝技——超级角击吗？
strings.en: I see you’ve already{NEWLINE}earned the Hive Badge.{SCROLL}So, would you like to learn our Azalea{NEWLINE}Gym’s Bug-type secret move, Megahorn?
